text: I am writing to report a serious safety incident. The ProHeat 3000 space heater I purchased from you last month started smoking heavily and then caught fire while operating normally on a standard household outlet. It burned a significant portion of my desk and could easily have spread to the rest of the room. I have photographs and video of the damage and the unit. This product is dangerous and needs to be recalled. I am retaining all evidence and will be consulting with a product liability attorney.
